full_judgment: 9. We have perused the impugned judgment and found that the High Court Division wrongly placed in onus that the Government so as to show that the property is an abandoned property within the purview of the PO No. 16 of 1972 and has lost sight of the fact that since the property has attained the character of an abandoned property and accordingly automatically vested in the Government as the abandoned property and the burden of proof is upon the respondent to show that the property is not an abandoned property and the provision of PO No. 16 of 1972 shall have the effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent contained in any other law for the time being in force.
